g.text: Coated cochlear implants insert with about half the force, in three studies
Peak insertion force of cochlear implant electrode arrays in human cadaveric cochleae (Bennion 2021, Peel 2024) and in a synthetic cochlea
(NIH SBIR Phase I dataset); mean ± SD where published
